policy: Local, source-checked 2011 pilot with 11 selected events, not comprehensive world coverage or a live feed. Events belong only to their start month. Up to three per source-backed event-location country; no fabricated fills for missing months or countries. Exact coordinate and media-date limitations are recorded per entry.
events: Protesters gathered in Cairo's Tahrir Square on January 25. Human Rights Watch staff witnessed the demonstrations on January 25 and 26.

source.title: Human Rights Watch: Egypt — End Crackdown on Peaceful Demonstrations
Human Rights Watch: Egypt — End Crackdown on Peaceful Demonstrations

monthlyReview.notes: Start-day entry, not a claim that the protests lasted only one day. January 28 footage belongs to this protest movement; the February 8 photograph is later than the selected start month.
monthlyReview.coordinates: Existing catalog coordinates retained as an approximate event-area marker; source confirms the named place and country, not exact latitude and longitude.
